description: Throughout all strict linear orders, no universal formula is equivalent to \(\exists y\,(x<y)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PreservationConverses.above_not_universal :
  ¬∃ ψ,
      FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsUniversal ψ ∧
        ∀ (M : Type) (r : M → M → Prop),
          IsStrictTotalOrder M r →
            have this := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.binaryRelStructure M r;
            ∀ (a : Fin 1 → M), ψ.Realize a ↔ Lemmatheca.Entry.PreservationConverses.above.Realize a
